selection_rule: Candidate semantic subjects and ordered answers are frozen before exact Gradle temporal source acquisition. Candidates are evaluated in listed rank order. The first four eligible candidates fill bpd-gradle-tc-01..04. Eligibility requires four unique Gradle-authored pinned source snapshots, at least three required producer allocations, exact support for the ordered answer, at least one required evidence state separated from another by 180 days or more, a genuine stale-versus-current semantic conflict, and no exact source-byte reuse with any previously selected confirmatory case. Rejection is permitted only for frozen source-integrity/design failures; treatment or evaluator outcomes may not be observed or used.
